chunks: Muḥammad ibn Qays narrated from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said:
Do not employ a foolish woman as a wet nurse, for milk transmits traits, and the boy inclines toward the milk—that is, toward the wet nurse—in rashness and foolishness.

key_terms.اللَّبَنَ: milk; understood here as having an influence that transmits qualities
key_terms.الْحَمْقَاءَ: a foolish woman; here, a woman lacking sound judgment chosen as a wet nurse
key_terms.الْغُلَامَ: the boy or child being nursed
key_terms.يُعْدِي: transmits or passes on effects from one to another

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about choosing a wet nurse for a child?
ai.summary: This hadith advises care in choosing a wet nurse, warning that the child may be affected by the traits associated with the one who nurses him. It reflects the importance of moral and personal qualities in matters connected to child rearing and family life.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4679 - Muhammad ibn Qays narrated from Abu Ja'far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) who said that the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) said: "
Do not choose a foolish woman as a wet nurse, for milk can transmit traits. A child is influenced by the milk, meaning by the wet nurse, in foolishness and ignorance."
